proof_audit.reason: CFADS is before financing and treats a working-capital increase as cash use. Earnings deduct stipulated depreciation and interest while principal repays a liability. Independently generating each scheduled principal tranche with coupons through its maturity reconstructs opening principal and all service dates; loan plus sponsor proceeds fund the initial purchase and cash anew.

The recursion telescopes to cutoff source/use sums. Including t=0 is necessary to catch an unfunded purchase. Under fixed timing, no cash interest and no new cash uses, every floor inequality is necessary and sufficient; max(0,c-min C) shifts all dates enough and any smaller amount fails at a minimizing date. A floor breach is explicitly separated from a negative balance/payment shortage, and annual endpoints do not resolve intrayear needs.

Downturn DSCR below one is financed from retained cash in the revision, while all three downside ratios breach 1.2. Base-only coverage gating and separate all-scenario cash gating are clearly defined. No waiver, acceleration, overdraft or postdefault completion is silently implemented. Six conjunctive gates allow evidence hold or committee review only after the relevant quantitative tests pass.

At default immediately before the selected payment, current principal and earned coupon enter the claim, while future coupons do not. Nonnegative payments, claim caps, conservation and the rule that an unpaid earlier claim blocks every later claimant uniquely specify the waterfall. Prior payments, recovery at d+lag and excluded postdefault operating/going-concern cash are explicit.

proof_audit.reason: Backward discounting of actual dated receipt streams independently gives promised and default PVs. A chosen physical mixture is not inferred from the two unweighted operating stresses and is not a Q price. With fixed ordered branch PVs, expected margin decreases affinely in p; the largest weight follows from one inequality. Changing discount rate or recovery timing requires recomputation.

For the two stipulated actions and face in [0,120], statewise lender/equity splits conserve asset value and give gamble-minus-prudent equity F/2-20. The officer comparison is .10k-1; equality gives indifference. The repaired wording correctly distinguishes lender gross benefit4 from combined surplus3 before compensation/penalty transfers. Enforceability and information assumptions bound the result.

source_audit.inspection: Independent official30-page PDF reopening: cover narrative March1990/procedures March1998 and reputation-risk-reference removal March20,2025; printed pp14–16 financial commitments, cash service, primary repayment and realizability; printed p20 covenants, timely information and collateral controls. source_audit.result: Scope supports the limited attribution. Original math/cases do not require an unseen source theorem. No additional unresolved specialist source fact.

independent_computation: Separate checker generates annual service as a matrix of principal tranches with coupons through each maturity, certifies cutoff source/use sums and minimum injections, verifies waterfall uniqueness using caps/conservation/strict-priority conditions, and values physical dated cash backward. It never imports the author checker or candidate arithmetic helpers. Exact exercise/policy thresholds and financial/evidence interventions go beyond saved-output reproduction.

findings.observed: Original CLI resolve-only protection accepted an existing hard-link alias of the input as --output. A disposable copy exited0 and overwrote input bytes from1725 to11429. The same inode mechanism also affected the implementation path.
findings.repair: Coordinator added samefile checks and direct/symbolic/hard-link preservation tests, updated README, manifest, author record and frozen peer assignment in production/v11-c03-alias-repair.json. Final peer tests independently repeat both protected paths and both optimization modes.

limitations: Internal machine-assisted peer work is not independent human academic certification or coordinator acceptance.
Synthetic forecasts, probabilities, collateral rights, priorities, officer incentives and policy gates are stipulated; calculations cannot authenticate documents or estimate real default risk.
Annual cash dates omit intrayear timing. Conditional projections after a shortfall are not funded payments; covenant acceleration or waiver requires a changed model.
The assessment rate and omitted additional costs limit the scenario margin; no state-price law or actual market fair value is identified.
Bounded exact checks do not exhaust all valid inputs. Full-edition dependency, browser, mobile, keyboard and print checks remain coordinated separately.
